messages.subject: add an item to a list on a java bean
messages.subject_clean: add an item to a list on a java bean
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I am using renjin called from java code. I have a script.R in which i use beans for exemple a bean person (name='john', addresses=list(adresse1, adresse2))

I can 't add element to person.addresses

when i do :  person $addresses[[1]] <- Address$new(city="LA")

i get an exception :

java.lang.UnsupportedOperationException
        at org.renjin.invoke.reflection.converters.CollectionConverter.convertToJava(CollectionConverter.java:36)
        at org.renjin.invoke.reflection.PropertyBinding$Setter.setValue(PropertyBinding.java:57)
        at org.renjin.invoke.reflection.PropertyBinding.setValue(PropertyBinding.java:76)
        at org.renjin.sexp.ExternalPtr.setMember(ExternalPtr.java:71)
        at org.renjin.primitives.subset.Subsetting.setElementByName(Subsetting.java:90)
        at org.renjin.primitives.R$primitive$$$assign.doApply(R$primitive$$$assign.java:90)
        at org.renjin.primitives.R$primitive$$$assign.apply(R$primitive$$$assign.java:35)
        at org.renjin.eval.Context.evaluateCall(Context.java:261)
        at org.renjin.eval.Context.evaluate(Context.java:193)
        at org.renjin.primitives.special.AssignLeftFunction.assignLeft(AssignLeftFunction.java:75)
        at org.renjin.primitives.special.AssignLeftFunction.apply(AssignLeftFunction.java:44)
        at org.renjin.eval.Context.evaluateCall(Context.java:261)
        at org.renjin.eval.Context.evaluate(Context.java:193)
        at org.renjin.primitives.special.BeginFunction.apply(BeginFunction.java:46)
        at org.renjin.eval.Context.evaluateCall(Context.java:261)
        at org.renjin.eval.Context.evaluate(Context.java:193)
        at org.renjin.primitives.special.ForFunction.apply(ForFunction.java:59)
        at org.renjin.eval.Context.evaluateCall(Context.java:261)
        at org.renjin.eval.Context.evaluate(Context.java:193)
        at org.renjin.primitives.special.BeginFunction.apply(BeginFunction.java:46)
        at org.renjin.eval.Context.evaluateCall(Context.java:261)
        at org.renjin.eval.Context.evaluate(Context.java:193)
        at org.renjin.primitives.special.IfFunction.apply(IfFunction.java:46)

I have import in the beggining:

import (java.math.BigDecimal)
import (java.math.MathContext)
import (java.math.RoundingMode)
import (java.util.List)
import (java.util.HashMap)

Thank's for your help,
Best Regards,

messages.body_plain:
Hi Selma,
Is person$addresses a java.util.Set or java.util.List? Perhaps you can try person$addresses$add(Address$new(city="LA")) ?
